title: $1.6 billion: India AI funding doubles in 2026
takeaways: $1.6 billion raised in Jan–Sep 2026, up 96% year on year.
Ten largest rounds took 90% of all AI funding.
Neysa's $600 million Series B was 37% of the total.
Only 3% of Indian firms say their data is fully AI-ready.
source_note: Sources: Tracxn via PTI, 24 Nov 2026; Dun & Bradstreet, Nov 2026
